messages:
maria: Quick PR up to add a 'Retention exceptions matrix' to the SOC2 docs — need legal + security signoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2145 :link:

jonathan: Quick read — high level looks good. tiny wording nit: avoid 'customer data' when talking about audit logs. Suggest 'tenant audit events' or 'organizational audit records'.

maria: good point. I'll swap phrasing. Also calling out exception cases for subpoena/legal hold, research requests, and support escalations. Do we have authoritative wording for these?

helen (SOC2 auditor): For SOC2 we need the canonical line: 'Retention may be extended when required by law, regulation, or contractual obligation.' Avoid enumerating exhaustive examples in the main paragraph — keep them as parenthetical, non-exhaustive examples.

anya: Security note: please don't state we redact PII from audit logs automatically. We have selective redaction during ingestion for known-sensitive fields, and customer-configurable retention/redaction policies. Docs should say 'optional PII redaction at ingestion or via customer-configured policies' instead.

sam: Implementation clarification: retention worker runs daily at 03:00 UTC and deletes records older than the configured retention window. We also snapshot indices monthly for backup retention. So wording like 'deleted within 24 hours' is inaccurate — use 'deleted by the next scheduled retention job (within 24 hours on average)'.

maria: ok i'll update timeline text. Also adding an SDK/config snippet for internal migration guides — sanity-check please:

```
# python (internal-only example)
# set retention for tenant with a legal hold flag (internal admin API)
client.update_audit_retention(tenant_id="acme-corp", retention_days=90, exceptions=["legal_hold"])
```

jonathan: That looks fine as an internal example but call it out clearly as 'internal admin API' and don't include it in public-facing docs. Also avoid implying that arbitrary customers can set exceptions unless they have the contract.

maria: updated PR with internal-only banner above the snippet and a note about contractual gating. pinging @helen and @anya for final signoff :eyes:

ci-bot: build passed — link checker OK, no broken anchors.

docs-bot: 'exceptions matrix' table added and wording migrated per legal suggestions.

helen: Approved the revised wording for the SOC2 section. One tiny ask: remove the 'e.g.' examples from the section header — keep them in a footnote under 'Exceptions and extensions'.

anya: Approved security phrasing. Also add a brief line about KMS/HSM audit logs retention for Private deployments (we keep KMS audit trails per customer KMS policy).

maria: will add a KMS note under 'Private deployment considerations'. Action items rundown:
- maria: update PR text + move examples to footnote (in progress)
- sam: confirm daily job phrasing (done)
- jonathan: confirm internal snippet gating language (done)
- helen + anya: final signoff (both approved)
Target: merge by EOD Fri.

sam: Confirmed — comments about worker scheduling and snapshot cadence added inline.

maria: thanks all — PR link (updated): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2145. Merging after CI green and final tiny copyedit. :thumbsup:
